metadata.title: Lottery ZIP Psychographics: How Neighborhoods Play
caveats: The file does not include the original time-window metadata; pre_ fields are treated as a baseline period.
Demographics are not used to fit PCA, factor analysis, or clusters.
Channel-context shares can overlap and should not be read as mutually exclusive market shares.
The gallery uses borough grouping rather than a precise ZIP polygon map because geometry is not in the file.

loadings.name: Daily habit / social routine versus rapid-resolution play

clusterDiagnostics.chosen: k=3 keeps the segment story operational; higher k mostly peels out small outlier groups.

segments.label: Routine Daily-Number ZIPs
segments.description: Daily Numbers, habit index, and social-channel context are high. The segment is behaviorally regular before it is demographically explained.
segments.strategy: Read these as routine play neighborhoods, not simply high-sales ZIPs.

segments.label: Convenience Scratch / Quickdraw ZIPs
segments.description: Instant tickets, Quick Draw, retailer density, and routine checkout context make this the fast-resolution convenience segment.
segments.strategy: The behavioral signature is speed plus availability.

segments.label: Affluent Jackpot / Incidental ZIPs
segments.description: More jackpot, add-on, and incidental play with higher income and education showing up only after the behavior model is fit.
segments.strategy: Use this as the contrast case: lottery play can look more episodic and jackpot-led.
